run_download_wafer: run the download_wafer function to download and extract wafer dataset files to a destination directory
run_download_file: run the download_file function to download a file from a URL with progress bar and overwrite support
run_download_data_cli: run the download_data.py CLI module to download the wafer dataset with --dest_dir and --overwrite flags
test_download_wafer: test the download_wafer function to download, extract, and clean up wafer tar.gz files
test_download_file: test the download_file function to stream download a file with tqdm progress and size checking
